style: hand-painted 3D chibi collectible-doll animation matching the supplied model sheet: oversized heads, three-head-tall bodies, watercolor-gouache texture, soft flat fluorescent lighting. Deadpan realism: no comedy music, no reaction stickers, no explanatory graphics.
stage: An ordinary small Chinese 24-hour convenience store at 4:30 AM. Checkout counter on LEFT; open floor and vertical smartphone on ring-light tripod at CENTER; low snack rack on RIGHT with a narrow visible floor patch behind it; blue pre-dawn light through the glass storefront. Real China, 2026.

characters.identity_desc: SHA-SHA, adult fashionable woman: dark skin, exact platinum-blonde braided buns, multiple metallic earrings and necklace, patterned gray jacket, pale tulle skirt, beige boots; exact model-sheet proportions
characters.voice_desc: adult female Mandarin with a strong northeastern Chinese comedic accent (dongbei livestreamer). Two registers: while bragging she is LOUD, swaggering and fast like a street boss; after seeing the body her voice CRACKS into a falsetto yelp then deflates to a breathy, half-dead whimper. The tonal fall from bravado to wheeze IS the performance

characters.identity_desc: XIAO-BAI, 19-year-old night-shift clerk: very pale skin, exact short white bob, salmon-pink work jacket with silver name badge, black shorts, white boots; exact model-sheet proportions
characters.voice_desc: young clear female Mandarin voice with a light northeastern tint, blunt direct questions, growing worry she tries to hide

props.desc: one vertical black smartphone mounted inside one small circular ring light on one black tripod, camera facing the store floor
one tiny black wireless lavalier microphone
props.persistent_state: clipped to the collar of SHA-SHA's PHYSICAL body at all times; the transparent spirit never has it

spatial_layout: phone_rig remains upright at CENTER facing SHA-SHA's performance area
snack rack remains on RIGHT with the reveal floor patch visible behind its lower edge
environment: same 4:30 AM fluorescent convenience-store interior throughout
no customers and no other staff appear
blue pre-dawn light remains visible through the glass storefront
character_states: XIAO-BAI remains behind or immediately beside the LEFT checkout counter
in shots r01-r03 SHA-SHA appears as a normal OPAQUE person (she is actually already dead but neither she nor the picture shows it yet)
from shot r04 onward the standing SHA-SHA is a semi-transparent faintly glowing spirit, while her opaque physical body lies behind the RIGHT snack rack with the clip_mic on its collar

shots.speaker: xiaobai
shots.camera: Wide two-shot from slightly behind the phone_rig: SHA-SHA mid-dance at CENTER, XIAO-BAI leaning out over the LEFT counter; RIGHT snack rack visible, body NOT visible
shots.action: XIAO-BAI leans her upper body over the counter, one hand pressed on the countertop, the other pointing at SHA-SHA's collar; SHA-SHA finishes a little livestream dance move, completely unaware
shots.line: 姐……你麦呢？我这边咋一点声没有了。
shots.start_state: SHA-SHA stands at CENTER facing the recording phone mid-dance; XIAO-BAI leans over the LEFT counter pointing at her collar; RIGHT snack rack hides the floor behind it
shots.end_state: XIAO-BAI is still pointing at SHA-SHA's empty collar; SHA-SHA has stopped dancing and is reaching toward her own collar
shots.gaze_target: XIAO-BAI looks at SHA-SHA's collar; SHA-SHA looks into phone_rig
pose_contract: XIAO-BAI's forearm rests on the checkout counter
shots.extra_constraints: SHA-SHA looks like a normal opaque person here. The only wrong detail: NO mic anywhere on her collar.

shots.speaker: shasha
shots.camera: Medium close-up on SHA-SHA at CENTER from the phone_rig's livestream angle
shots.action: She pinches at her empty collar where a mic should be and flicks it twice, finds nothing but keeps talking; then throws her chest out, chin up, one fist on her hip in full street-boss bravado, volume rising, playing to the camera
shots.line: 嗐，麦又抽风了呗——家人们别走啊，姐这精神头儿，包宿都不带打盹的！
time_beats: 0-3秒：捏空领口弹两下，什么都没摸到也不在意
3-8秒：挺胸叉腰对镜头放大嗓门吹牛
shots.end_state: SHA-SHA holds the fist-on-hip bragging pose facing phone_rig, mouth wide mid-shout
pose_contract: SHA-SHA remains standing on both feet at CENTER
shots.extra_constraints: Her hand passes at her EMPTY collar — there is no mic on her. Loud swaggering dongbei bravado delivery, the peak of her confidence.

shots.speaker: shasha
shots.camera: Side medium two-shot: XIAO-BAI at LEFT counter pointing right toward the snack rack, SHA-SHA at CENTER turning to follow the point
shots.action: XIAO-BAI silently points twice toward the RIGHT snack rack with an uneasy face. SHA-SHA waves a dismissive hand, then swivels with exaggerated nimble energy, striding toward the rack while boasting over her shoulder at the camera
shots.line: 掉那儿了？我给它捡回来——你瞅姐这利索劲儿，还跟年轻那会儿一个样，永远十八！
time_beats: 0-2秒：小白朝货架方向点了两下手指，欲言又止
2-8秒：莎莎摆手，转身大步流星走向货架，边走边回头冲镜头吹牛
shots.end_state: SHA-SHA has reached the near side of the snack rack mid-stride, one foot planted, head still half-turned back toward the camera finishing the boast; XIAO-BAI watches frozen from the counter
shots.gaze_target: SHA-SHA glances back at phone_rig while walking; XIAO-BAI stares after her
shot_delta: SHA-SHA moves from CENTER to the near side of the RIGHT snack rack
shots.extra_constraints: This is the last beat of full bravado — deliver 永远十八 loud and cocky. The floor behind the rack is still NOT visible in this framing.

shots.speaker: shasha
shots.camera: High three-quarter angle over the RIGHT snack rack: translucent spirit SHA-SHA in foreground frozen mid-reach, and her own OPAQUE physical body lying rigid on the floor behind the rack, the black clip_mic on the body's collar
shots.action: Her reaching hand freezes in midair above the body, fingers stay open, never closing. Her head tilts down locked on the body. The yelp cracks out of her, then all air leaves her voice
time_beats: 0-2秒：伸向地面的手悬停半空，指尖张着，低头看清地上的自己
2-4秒：破音惨叫'哎呀我套！'，整个身体往后缩了一下
4-7秒：突然泄气，用又贱又惨的气声挤出'……屎了……'
shots.start_state: Spirit SHA-SHA stands at the rack's near side bending forward, hand reaching down; over the rack the opaque body is now clearly visible lying flat, clip_mic on its collar
shots.end_state: Spirit SHA-SHA has recoiled half a step, hand still hanging in midair unclosed, staring down at the body; the body unmoved, mic on its collar
shots.gaze_target: spirit SHA-SHA stares down at her own body
pose_contract: opaque physical body lies fully supported by the floor, perfectly still
spirit remains standing, weight on both feet
shot_delta: the opaque physical body becomes visible behind the RIGHT snack rack
shots.extra_constraints: THE PEAK. Voice does a hard fall: cracked falsetto scream on 哎呀我套, then a deflated wheezy comic-miserable delivery of 屎了 (dongbei slang, sounds like 'shi le'). TWO identical SHA-SHAs in one frame: standing translucent spirit with NO mic, opaque floor body WITH the only mic. No gore, eyes of the body closed.

shots.speaker: shasha
shots.camera: Medium close-up on the spirit beside the rack, body's legs still visible at frame bottom
shots.action: Her raised hand slowly flips palm-up and the fingers fall open in surrender; her other hand drags down her own cheek; shoulders sag, all swagger gone
shots.end_state: Spirit SHA-SHA stands deflated beside the rack, palm-up hand hanging, other hand on her cheek, eyes still on the body below frame
pose_contract: spirit remains standing beside the rack, shoulders slumped
shots.extra_constraints: FINAL SHOT of the film. Total self-surrender, breathy dragging tone, tail of the sentence leaks air. She surrenders to HERSELF, not to anyone else — she asks nobody for help. No scream, no tears, no turning toward anyone. HARD CUT the instant the trailing air of the last syllable ends, while she is still staring down.
